lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuAuTe₂ crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Cu₂Au₂Te₄—and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers in an octahedral environment with six Te neighbors, Cu centers with six Te neighbors, and Te centers with three Au and three Cu neighbors. The Au-centered octahedra share edges, and Cu-centered six-vertex polyhedra share corners with Au octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
